_comment: Header-only bulk regression corpus for mail-jxa.ts isBulk. Bulk cases are trimmed recordings from a real inbox (2026-11); person and transactional cases keep the header names real person-to-person, helpdesk and transactional mail carry. Addresses of private people are fictional.
